title: Closed-fibre open-image finiteness over a DVR
statement: Let $R$ be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], put $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$, let $s=\operatorname{Spec}(R/\mathfrak m_R)$ be its closed point, and let $\ell$ be a prime that is a unit in $R$. Put $A=\mathbf F_\ell$. Let $T\to S$ be separated of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $j:V\hookrightarrow T$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $F$ be a constructible sheaf of modules over the constant sheaf $A_V$ on the ordinary small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $i:T_s=T\times_Ss\to T$ for the closed-fibre map. Then every $i^{-1}R^qj_*F$ is constructible on $T_s$, and there is $b\geq0$ such that $i^{-1}R^qj_*F=0$ for every $q>b$ [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. No henselian, completeness, or excellence hypothesis on $R$ is imposed; no assertion is made here about $R^qj_*F$ away from the closed fibre.

source.place: Expose XIII, Theorem 2.3.1(i), printed p.197, local regular dimension-one case in the proof, restricted to the closed fibre. Also follows from Zheng, literature/zheng-six-operations-lefschetz-verdier-DM-stacks_arXiv-1006.3810.pdf, Proposition 3.16(1), printed p.19, regular-base alternative, restricted to schemes over Spec R and then to the closed fibre.

from.place: Proof Step 1, dimension-normalized Verdier duality, via the regular finite-torsion duality input: the local biduality invoked in ILO Expose XVI, Lemma 3.5.9 proof, printed p.250, before the purity of the target is proved. Here: constructibility of the biduality cone before the dimension-one projective-line induction. Specifically: the open direct-image finiteness input in the Noetherian open/closed devissage proving low-base internal-Hom finiteness. Residual closed-fibre finiteness at each exceptional closed base point, after localization to its DVR; not a theorem about the entire nonlocal base.
